am-ET.old_line: - **የሂሳብ መዝገቦች፦** የዩኬ የግብር ሕግ በሚጠይቀው መሠረት፣ የሚመለከተው የሂሳብ ዓመት ካበቃ ጀምሮ ለስድስት ዓመታት።
am-ET.new_line: - **የሂሳብ መዝገቦች፦** የሚመለከተው የሂሳብ ዓመት ካበቃ ጀምሮ ቢያንስ ለስድስት ዓመታት፣ ሕጉ በሚጠይቅበት ሁኔታ ደግሞ ለአሥር ዓመታት።
am-ET.back: at least for six years from the end of the relevant accounting year, and where the law requires it, for ten years.
am-ET.notes: 'የሂሳብ ዓመት' reused from old line for financial year.

ar-AE.old_line: - **السجلات المحاسبية:** ست سنوات من نهاية السنة المالية المعنية، وفقًا لما يقتضيه قانون الضرائب في المملكة المتحدة.
ar-AE.new_line: - **السجلات المحاسبية:** ست سنوات على الأقل من نهاية السنة المالية المعنية، وعشر سنوات حيثما يقتضي القانون ذلك.
ar-AE.back: six years at least from the end of the relevant financial year, and ten years wherever the law requires that.

az-AZ.old_line: - **Mühasibat qeydləri:** Birləşmiş Krallığın vergi qanunvericiliyinin tələb etdiyi kimi, müvafiq maliyyə ilinin sonundan altı il.
az-AZ.new_line: - **Mühasibat qeydləri:** müvafiq maliyyə ilinin sonundan ən azı altı il, qanunun tələb etdiyi hallarda isə on il.
az-AZ.back: at least six years from the end of the relevant financial year, and ten years in cases where the law requires it.
az-AZ.notes: Text after the label now starts lowercase (old started with a proper noun); matches other bullets.

bg-BG.old_line: - **Счетоводни документи:** шест години от края на съответната финансова година, както изисква данъчното законодателство на Обединеното кралство.
bg-BG.new_line: - **Счетоводни документи:** най-малко шест години от края на съответната финансова година и десет години, когато законът го изисква.
bg-BG.back: at least six years from the end of the relevant financial year and ten years when the law requires it.

bn-BD.old_line: - **হিসাবের রেকর্ড:** সংশ্লিষ্ট অর্থবছর শেষ হওয়ার পর থেকে ছয় বছর, যেমনটি UK-এর কর আইন দাবি করে।
bn-BD.new_line: - **হিসাবের রেকর্ড:** সংশ্লিষ্ট অর্থবছর শেষ হওয়ার পর থেকে অন্তত ছয় বছর, এবং আইন যেখানে দাবি করে সেখানে দশ বছর।
bn-BD.back: at least six years from the end of the relevant financial year, and ten years where the law demands it.

bs-BA.old_line: - **Računovodstveni zapisi:** šest godina od kraja odnosne finansijske godine, kako zahtijeva britanski poreski zakon.
bs-BA.new_line: - **Računovodstveni zapisi:** najmanje šest godina od kraja odnosne finansijske godine, a deset godina kada to zakon zahtijeva.
bs-BA.back: at least six years from the end of the relevant financial year, and ten years when the law requires it.

ca-AD.old_line: - **Registres comptables:** sis anys des del final de l’exercici corresponent, tal com exigeix la legislació fiscal del Regne Unit.
ca-AD.new_line: - **Registres comptables:** almenys sis anys des del final de l’exercici corresponent, i deu anys quan la llei ho exigeixi.
ca-AD.back: at least six years from the end of the relevant financial year, and ten years when the law requires it.

cs-CZ.old_line: - **Účetní záznamy:** šest let od konce příslušného účetního roku, jak vyžadují britské daňové předpisy.
cs-CZ.new_line: - **Účetní záznamy:** nejméně šest let od konce příslušného účetního roku a deset let tam, kde to vyžaduje zákon.
cs-CZ.back: at least six years from the end of the relevant accounting year and ten years where the law requires it.

da-DK.old_line: - **Regnskabsmateriale:** seks år fra udgangen af det pågældende regnskabsår, som britisk skattelovgivning kræver.
da-DK.new_line: - **Regnskabsmateriale:** mindst seks år fra udgangen af det pågældende regnskabsår og ti år, hvor loven kræver det.
da-DK.back: at least six years from the end of the relevant financial year and ten years where the law requires it.

de-DE.old_line: - **Buchhaltungsunterlagen:** sechs Jahre ab dem Ende des betreffenden Geschäftsjahres, wie es das Steuerrecht des Vereinigten Königreichs vorschreibt.
de-DE.new_line: - **Buchhaltungsunterlagen:** mindestens sechs Jahre ab dem Ende des betreffenden Geschäftsjahres und zehn Jahre, soweit das Gesetz dies vorschreibt.
de-DE.back: at least six years from the end of the relevant financial year and ten years insofar as the law prescribes it.

el-GR.old_line: - **Λογιστικά αρχεία:** έξι έτη από το τέλος του σχετικού οικονομικού έτους, όπως απαιτεί η φορολογική νομοθεσία του Ηνωμένου Βασιλείου.
el-GR.new_line: - **Λογιστικά αρχεία:** τουλάχιστον έξι έτη από το τέλος του σχετικού οικονομικού έτους και δέκα έτη όπου το απαιτεί ο νόμος.
el-GR.back: at least six years from the end of the relevant financial year and ten years where the law requires it.

es-ES.old_line: - **Registros contables:** seis años desde el final del ejercicio correspondiente, como exige la legislación tributaria del Reino Unido.
es-ES.new_line: - **Registros contables:** al menos seis años desde el final del ejercicio correspondiente, y diez años cuando la ley lo exija.
es-ES.back: at least six years from the end of the relevant financial year, and ten years when the law requires it.

et-EE.old_line: - **Raamatupidamisdokumendid:** kuus aastat asjaomase majandusaasta lõpust, nagu nõuab Ühendkuningriigi maksuseadus.
et-EE.new_line: - **Raamatupidamisdokumendid:** vähemalt kuus aastat asjaomase majandusaasta lõpust ja kümme aastat, kui seadus seda nõuab.
et-EE.back: at least six years from the end of the relevant financial year and ten years if the law requires it.

fi-FI.old_line: - **Kirjanpitoaineisto:** kuusi vuotta kyseisen tilikauden päättymisestä, kuten Yhdistyneen kuningaskunnan verolainsäädäntö edellyttää.
fi-FI.new_line: - **Kirjanpitoaineisto:** vähintään kuusi vuotta kyseisen tilikauden päättymisestä ja kymmenen vuotta, jos laki sitä edellyttää.
fi-FI.back: at least six years from the end of the relevant financial period and ten years if the law requires it.

fr-FR.old_line: - **Documents comptables :** six ans à compter de la fin de l’exercice concerné, comme l’exige le droit fiscal britannique.
fr-FR.new_line: - **Documents comptables :** au moins six ans à compter de la fin de l’exercice concerné, et dix ans lorsque la loi l’exige.
fr-FR.back: at least six years from the end of the relevant financial year, and ten years when the law requires it.
fr-FR.notes: French accounting law itself sets ten years (Code de commerce L123-22); wording is generic as in English.

he-IL.old_line: - **רשומות חשבונאיות:** שש שנים מתום שנת הכספים הרלוונטית, כנדרש בדיני המס של הממלכה המאוחדת.
he-IL.new_line: - **רשומות חשבונאיות:** שש שנים לפחות מתום שנת הכספים הרלוונטית, ועשר שנים כאשר החוק מחייב זאת.
he-IL.back: six years at least from the end of the relevant financial year, and ten years when the law requires it.

hr-HR.old_line: - **Računovodstvena evidencija:** šest godina od kraja odnosne financijske godine, kako to zahtijeva porezno zakonodavstvo Ujedinjene Kraljevine.
hr-HR.new_line: - **Računovodstvena evidencija:** najmanje šest godina od kraja odnosne financijske godine, a deset godina kada to zahtijeva zakon.
hr-HR.back: at least six years from the end of the relevant financial year, and ten years when the law requires it.

hu-HU.old_line: - **Számviteli nyilvántartások:** az adott pénzügyi év végétől számított hat évig, ahogyan azt az egyesült királysági adójog előírja.
hu-HU.new_line: - **Számviteli nyilvántartások:** az adott pénzügyi év végétől számított legalább hat évig, illetve tíz évig, ahol ezt jogszabály előírja.
hu-HU.back: for at least six years counted from the end of the relevant financial year, or ten years where legislation requires it.

hy-AM.old_line: - **Հաշվապահական գրառումներ՝** համապատասխան ֆինանսական տարվա ավարտից վեց տարի, ինչպես պահանջում է Միացյալ Թագավորության հարկային օրենսդրությունը։
hy-AM.new_line: - **Հաշվապահական գրառումներ՝** համապատասխան ֆինանսական տարվա ավարտից առնվազն վեց տարի, իսկ օրենքով պահանջվող դեպքերում՝ տասը տարի։
hy-AM.back: at least six years from the end of the relevant financial year, and in cases required by law, ten years.

id-ID.old_line: - **Catatan akuntansi:** enam tahun sejak akhir tahun buku yang bersangkutan, sebagaimana diwajibkan oleh hukum perpajakan Britania Raya.
id-ID.new_line: - **Catatan akuntansi:** sekurang-kurangnya enam tahun sejak akhir tahun buku yang bersangkutan, dan sepuluh tahun apabila diwajibkan oleh hukum.
id-ID.back: at least six years from the end of the relevant financial year, and ten years where required by law.

is-IS.old_line: - **Bókhaldsgögn:** sex ár frá lokum viðkomandi fjárhagsárs, eins og bresk skattalög krefjast.
is-IS.new_line: - **Bókhaldsgögn:** að minnsta kosti sex ár frá lokum viðkomandi fjárhagsárs og tíu ár þar sem lög krefjast þess.
is-IS.back: at least six years from the end of the relevant financial year and ten years where law requires it.

it-IT.old_line: - **Scritture contabili:** sei anni dalla fine dell'esercizio finanziario di riferimento, come richiesto dalla normativa fiscale del Regno Unito.
it-IT.new_line: - **Scritture contabili:** almeno sei anni dalla fine dell'esercizio finanziario di riferimento, e dieci anni ove richiesto dalla legge.
it-IT.back: at least six years from the end of the relevant financial year, and ten years where required by law.

ja-JP.old_line: - **会計記録:** 英国の税法の定めに従い、該当する会計年度の終了から六年間。
ja-JP.new_line: - **会計記録:** 該当する会計年度の終了から少なくとも六年間、法律が求める場合は十年間。
ja-JP.back: at least six years from the end of the relevant financial year; ten years where the law requires it.
ja-JP.notes: Kanji numerals kept as in the old line.

ka-GE.old_line: - **ბუღალტრული ჩანაწერები:** ექვსი წელი შესაბამისი ფინანსური წლის დასრულებიდან, როგორც ამას გაერთიანებული სამეფოს საგადასახადო კანონმდებლობა მოითხოვს.
ka-GE.new_line: - **ბუღალტრული ჩანაწერები:** სულ მცირე ექვსი წელი შესაბამისი ფინანსური წლის დასრულებიდან, ხოლო ათი წელი, როცა ამას კანონი მოითხოვს.
ka-GE.back: at least six years from the end of the relevant financial year, and ten years when the law requires it.

kk-KZ.old_line: - **Бухгалтерлік жазбалар:** Ұлыбританияның салық заңнамасы талап ететіндей, тиісті қаржы жылының соңынан бастап алты жыл.
kk-KZ.new_line: - **Бухгалтерлік жазбалар:** тиісті қаржы жылының соңынан бастап кемінде алты жыл, ал заң талап ететін жағдайларда — он жыл.
kk-KZ.back: at least six years from the end of the relevant financial year, and in cases the law requires, ten years.
kk-KZ.notes: Starts lowercase after the label (old started with a proper noun); matches other bullets.

km-KH.old_line: - **កំណត់ត្រាគណនេយ្យ៖** ប្រាំមួយឆ្នាំគិតចាប់ពីចុងឆ្នាំហិរញ្ញវត្ថុពាក់ព័ន្ធ ដូចដែលច្បាប់ពន្ធរបស់ចក្រភពអង់គ្លេសតម្រូវ។
km-KH.new_line: - **កំណត់ត្រាគណនេយ្យ៖** យ៉ាងហោចណាស់ប្រាំមួយឆ្នាំគិតចាប់ពីចុងឆ្នាំហិរញ្ញវត្ថុពាក់ព័ន្ធ និងដប់ឆ្នាំក្នុងករណីដែលច្បាប់តម្រូវ។
km-KH.back: at least six years counted from the end of the relevant financial year, and ten years in cases where the law requires.

ko-KR.old_line: - **회계 기록:** 영국 세법이 요구하는 바에 따라 해당 회계연도 종료일부터 육 년간.
ko-KR.new_line: - **회계 기록:** 해당 회계연도 종료일부터 최소 육 년간, 법률이 요구하는 경우에는 십 년간.
ko-KR.back: at least six years from the end date of the relevant financial year; ten years where the law requires it.
ko-KR.notes: Sino-Korean numerals in words kept as in the old line (육 년간 / 십 년간).

lo-LA.old_line: - **ບັນທຶກທາງບັນຊີ:** ຫົກປີ ນັບແຕ່ທ້າຍປີການເງິນທີ່ກ່ຽວຂ້ອງ ຕາມທີ່ກົດໝາຍພາສີຂອງສະຫະລາຊະອານາຈັກກຳນົດ.
lo-LA.new_line: - **ບັນທຶກທາງບັນຊີ:** ຢ່າງໜ້ອຍຫົກປີ ນັບແຕ່ທ້າຍປີການເງິນທີ່ກ່ຽວຂ້ອງ ແລະ ສິບປີ ໃນກໍລະນີທີ່ກົດໝາຍກຳນົດ.
lo-LA.back: at least six years counted from the end of the relevant financial year, and ten years in cases where the law prescribes.

lt-LT.old_line: - **Apskaitos įrašai:** šešerius metus nuo atitinkamų finansinių metų pabaigos, kaip reikalauja JK mokesčių įstatymai.
lt-LT.new_line: - **Apskaitos įrašai:** ne trumpiau kaip šešerius metus nuo atitinkamų finansinių metų pabaigos ir dešimt metų, kai to reikalauja įstatymai.
lt-LT.back: not less than six years from the end of the relevant financial year and ten years when the laws require it.

lv-LV.old_line: - **Grāmatvedības ieraksti:** sešus gadus no attiecīgā finanšu gada beigām, kā to prasa Apvienotās Karalistes nodokļu tiesību akti.
lv-LV.new_line: - **Grāmatvedības ieraksti:** vismaz sešus gadus no attiecīgā finanšu gada beigām un desmit gadus, ja to prasa tiesību akti.
lv-LV.back: at least six years from the end of the relevant financial year and ten years if legal acts require it.

mk-MK.old_line: - **Сметководствени записи:** шест години од крајот на соодветната финансиска година, како што бара даночното право на Обединетото Кралство.
mk-MK.new_line: - **Сметководствени записи:** најмалку шест години од крајот на соодветната финансиска година, а десет години кога тоа го бара законот.
mk-MK.back: at least six years from the end of the relevant financial year, and ten years when the law requires it.

mn-MN.old_line: - **Нягтлан бодох бүртгэлийн баримт:** Их Британийн татварын хуульд заасны дагуу холбогдох санхүүгийн жил дууссанаас хойш зургаан жил.
mn-MN.new_line: - **Нягтлан бодох бүртгэлийн баримт:** холбогдох санхүүгийн жил дууссанаас хойш дор хаяж зургаан жил, хуульд заасан тохиолдолд арван жил.
mn-MN.back: at least six years after the relevant financial year ends, ten years in cases specified by law.
mn-MN.notes: Starts lowercase after the label (old started with a proper noun); matches other bullets.

ms-MY.old_line: - **Rekod perakaunan:** enam tahun dari akhir tahun kewangan yang berkenaan, sebagaimana yang dikehendaki oleh undang-undang cukai UK.
ms-MY.new_line: - **Rekod perakaunan:** sekurang-kurangnya enam tahun dari akhir tahun kewangan yang berkenaan, dan sepuluh tahun jika dikehendaki oleh undang-undang.
ms-MY.back: at least six years from the end of the relevant financial year, and ten years if required by law.

nb-NO.old_line: - **Regnskapsmateriale:** seks år fra utgangen av det aktuelle regnskapsåret, slik britisk skattelovgivning krever.
nb-NO.new_line: - **Regnskapsmateriale:** minst seks år fra utgangen av det aktuelle regnskapsåret, og ti år der loven krever det.
nb-NO.back: at least six years from the end of the relevant financial year, and ten years where the law requires it.

ne-NP.old_line: - **लेखाका रेकर्डहरू:** बेलायतको कर कानुनले आवश्यक पारेअनुसार, सम्बन्धित आर्थिक वर्ष सकिएदेखि छ वर्षसम्म।
ne-NP.new_line: - **लेखाका रेकर्डहरू:** सम्बन्धित आर्थिक वर्ष सकिएदेखि कम्तीमा छ वर्षसम्म, र कानुनले आवश्यक पारेको अवस्थामा दस वर्षसम्म।
ne-NP.back: at least up to six years from the end of the relevant fiscal year, and up to ten years where the law requires it.

nl-NL.old_line: - **Boekhoudkundige gegevens:** zes jaar vanaf het einde van het betreffende boekjaar, zoals de Britse belastingwetgeving vereist.
nl-NL.new_line: - **Boekhoudkundige gegevens:** ten minste zes jaar vanaf het einde van het betreffende boekjaar, en tien jaar waar de wet dat vereist.
nl-NL.back: at least six years from the end of the relevant financial year, and ten years where the law requires it.

pl-PL.old_line: - **Dokumentacja księgowa:** sześć lat od końca danego roku obrotowego, zgodnie z wymogami brytyjskiego prawa podatkowego.
pl-PL.new_line: - **Dokumentacja księgowa:** co najmniej sześć lat od końca danego roku obrotowego, a dziesięć lat, jeżeli wymaga tego prawo.
pl-PL.back: at least six years from the end of the relevant financial year, and ten years if the law requires it.

pt-BR.old_line: - **Registros contábeis:** seis anos a partir do fim do exercício financeiro correspondente, conforme exige a legislação tributária do Reino Unido.
pt-BR.new_line: - **Registros contábeis:** no mínimo seis anos a partir do fim do exercício financeiro correspondente, e dez anos quando a lei exigir.
pt-BR.back: at minimum six years from the end of the relevant financial year, and ten years when the law requires.

pt-PT.old_line: - **Registos contabilísticos:** seis anos a contar do fim do exercício financeiro em causa, conforme exige a legislação fiscal do Reino Unido.
pt-PT.new_line: - **Registos contabilísticos:** pelo menos seis anos a contar do fim do exercício financeiro em causa, e dez anos quando a lei o exija.
pt-PT.back: at least six years from the end of the relevant financial year, and ten years when the law requires it.

ro-RO.old_line: - **Evidențele contabile:** șase ani de la sfârșitul exercițiului financiar respectiv, conform cerințelor legislației fiscale din Regatul Unit.
ro-RO.new_line: - **Evidențele contabile:** cel puțin șase ani de la sfârșitul exercițiului financiar respectiv și zece ani în cazurile în care legea impune acest lucru.
ro-RO.back: at least six years from the end of the relevant financial year and ten years in cases where the law requires it.

ru-KZ.old_line: - **Бухгалтерские записи:** шесть лет с конца соответствующего финансового года, как того требует налоговое законодательство Великобритании.
ru-KZ.new_line: - **Бухгалтерские записи:** не менее шести лет с конца соответствующего финансового года, а в случаях, предусмотренных законом, — десять лет.
ru-KZ.back: no less than six years from the end of the relevant financial year, and in cases provided for by law, ten years.

si-LK.old_line: - **ගිණුම්කරණ වාර්තා:** එක්සත් රාජධානියේ බදු නීතියට අනුව, අදාළ මූල්‍ය වර්ෂය අවසන් වූ දින සිට වසර හයක්.
si-LK.new_line: - **ගිණුම්කරණ වාර්තා:** අදාළ මූල්‍ය වර්ෂය අවසන් වූ දින සිට අවම වශයෙන් වසර හයක්, සහ නීතියෙන් අවශ්‍ය වන අවස්ථාවල වසර දහයක්.
si-LK.back: at least six years from the date the relevant financial year ends, and ten years in cases where the law requires it.
si-LK.notes: Check ZWJ conjuncts render as in the old line.

sk-SK.old_line: - **Účtovné záznamy:** šesť rokov od konca príslušného účtovného roka, ako to vyžadujú daňové predpisy Spojeného kráľovstva.
sk-SK.new_line: - **Účtovné záznamy:** najmenej šesť rokov od konca príslušného účtovného roka a desať rokov, ak to vyžaduje zákon.
sk-SK.back: at least six years from the end of the relevant accounting year and ten years if the law requires it.

sl-SI.old_line: - **Računovodske evidence:** šest let od konca zadevnega poslovnega leta, kot zahteva davčna zakonodaja Združenega kraljestva.
sl-SI.new_line: - **Računovodske evidence:** najmanj šest let od konca zadevnega poslovnega leta in deset let, kadar to zahteva zakon.
sl-SI.back: at least six years from the end of the relevant business year and ten years when the law requires it.

sq-AL.old_line: - **Regjistrimet kontabël:** gjashtë vjet nga fundi i vitit financiar përkatës, siç kërkon ligji tatimor i Mbretërisë së Bashkuar.
sq-AL.new_line: - **Regjistrimet kontabël:** të paktën gjashtë vjet nga fundi i vitit financiar përkatës, dhe dhjetë vjet kur e kërkon ligji.
sq-AL.back: at least six years from the end of the relevant financial year, and ten years when the law requires it.

sr-RS.old_line: - **Računovodstvena evidencija:** šest godina od kraja odnosne finansijske godine, kako to zahtevaju poreski propisi Ujedinjenog Kraljevstva.
sr-RS.new_line: - **Računovodstvena evidencija:** najmanje šest godina od kraja odnosne finansijske godine, a deset godina kada to zahteva zakon.
sr-RS.back: at least six years from the end of the relevant financial year, and ten years when the law requires it.

sv-SE.old_line: - **Bokföringsunderlag:** sex år från utgången av det aktuella räkenskapsåret, enligt kraven i brittisk skattelagstiftning.
sv-SE.new_line: - **Bokföringsunderlag:** minst sex år från utgången av det aktuella räkenskapsåret, och tio år där lagen kräver det.
sv-SE.back: at least six years from the end of the relevant financial year, and ten years where the law requires it.

sw-TZ.old_line: - **Rekodi za kihasibu:** miaka sita kuanzia mwisho wa mwaka wa fedha husika, kama sheria ya kodi ya Uingereza inavyotaka.
sw-TZ.new_line: - **Rekodi za kihasibu:** angalau miaka sita kuanzia mwisho wa mwaka wa fedha husika, na miaka kumi pale sheria inapotaka hivyo.
sw-TZ.back: at least six years from the end of the relevant financial year, and ten years where the law requires so.

th-TH.old_line: - **บันทึกทางบัญชี:** หกปีนับแต่สิ้นปีบัญชีที่เกี่ยวข้อง ตามที่กฎหมายภาษีของสหราชอาณาจักรกำหนด
th-TH.new_line: - **บันทึกทางบัญชี:** อย่างน้อยหกปีนับแต่สิ้นปีบัญชีที่เกี่ยวข้อง และสิบปีในกรณีที่กฎหมายกำหนด
th-TH.back: at least six years from the end of the relevant accounting year, and ten years in cases the law prescribes
th-TH.notes: No end punctuation, as in the old line (Thai style).

tr-TR.old_line: - **Muhasebe kayıtları:** Birleşik Krallık vergi mevzuatının gerektirdiği şekilde, ilgili mali yılın sonundan itibaren altı yıl.
tr-TR.new_line: - **Muhasebe kayıtları:** ilgili mali yılın sonundan itibaren en az altı yıl, kanunun gerektirdiği durumlarda ise on yıl.
tr-TR.back: at least six years from the end of the relevant financial year, and ten years in cases the law requires.
tr-TR.notes: Starts lowercase after the label (old started with a proper noun); matches other bullets.

uk-UA.old_line: - **Бухгалтерські записи:** шість років від кінця відповідного фінансового року, як цього вимагає податкове законодавство Великої Британії.
uk-UA.new_line: - **Бухгалтерські записи:** щонайменше шість років від кінця відповідного фінансового року, а у випадках, передбачених законом, — десять років.
uk-UA.back: at least six years from the end of the relevant financial year, and in cases provided for by law, ten years.

uz-UZ.old_line: - **Buxgalteriya yozuvlari:** Buyuk Britaniya soliq qonunchiligi talab qilganidek, tegishli moliya yili tugaganidan keyin olti yil.
uz-UZ.new_line: - **Buxgalteriya yozuvlari:** tegishli moliya yili tugaganidan keyin kamida olti yil, qonun talab qilgan hollarda esa oʻn yil.
uz-UZ.back: at least six years after the relevant financial year ends, and ten years in cases where the law requires.
uz-UZ.notes: Uses U+02BB in 'oʻn' as the file does elsewhere.

zh-HK.old_line: - **會計紀錄：** 按英國稅務法律規定，由有關財政年度結束起計六年。
zh-HK.new_line: - **會計紀錄：** 由有關財政年度結束起計最少六年，如法律有所規定，則為十年。
zh-HK.back: at least six years counted from the end of the relevant financial year; where the law so provides, ten years.

zh-TW.old_line: - **會計紀錄：** 依英國稅法規定，自相關會計年度結束起六年。
zh-TW.new_line: - **會計紀錄：** 自相關會計年度結束起至少六年，如法律有規定，則為十年。
zh-TW.back: at least six years from the end of the relevant accounting year; where the law so provides, ten years.
